name: The Oath
subtitle: Mirkwood Paths
text:
You are playing Campaign Mode.
Setup: Each player chooses 1 Adaptation boon attachment and attaches it to one of their heroes. Shuffle the Stalking Goblin burden enemy into the encounter deck. Add Stalking Goblin and each attached Adaptation to the Campaign Pool.
Forced: At the end of each round, place 1 resource token here.
back_text: Resolution: If there are 6 or more resource tokens here, the thought of the captured villagers suffering weighs heavily on you. Add the Guilty Conscience treachery burden to the Campaign Pool.

name: The Caves of Nibin-Dûm
subtitle: Mirkwood Paths
text:
You are playing Campaign Mode.
Setup: Each player adds 1 copy of the "No Time to Waste!" boon to their hand after drawing their starting hand (including taking a mulligan). Add each copy of "No Time to Waste!" in a player's hand to the Campaign Pool. Shuffle the Shiny Distraction burden into the encounter deck and add it to the Campaign Pool.
back_text: Resolution: Check the final threat of the player with the highest threat: If it is under 40, you have rescued a retired Ranger who shares his wisdom with you. Each player may add 1 copy of Ranger Sense to their deck and to the Campaign Pool. At the start of your next campaign, each player may also shuffle 1 copy of Ranger Sense into their deck and add it to the Campaign Pool.

name: Stalking Goblin
text:
Forced: After Stalking Goblin engages you, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and your collection (in that order) for a Goblin Sniper and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
Shadow: Add Stalking Goblin to the staging area.

name: Shiny Distraction
text:
Surge. Doomed 1.
When Revealed: Each player may add 1 resource to each of their heroes' pools. Each player that does raises their threat by 5.

name: Guilty Conscience
text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Attach to the hero with the highest threat cost. (Counts as an Adaptation attachment with the text: "Forced: Raise your threat by 2 at the end of each round. Action: Spend 2 resources from attached hero's pool to discard this card.")

name: The Fervor of Lore
text:
Setup. Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains the [lore] resource icon.
Action: Choose and discard 3 cards from your hand to heal all damage from a hero. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

name: The Might of Tactics
text:
Setup. Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains the [tactics] resource icon.
Action: Deal 1 damage to the attached hero to deal 3 damage to an enemy engaged with you. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

name: The Power of Spirit
text:
Setup. Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains the [spirit] resource icon.
Action: Exhaust the attached hero to place 3 progress on a location. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

name: The Secret of Leadership
text:
Setup. Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains the [leadership] resource icon.
Action: Spend 1 resource from the attached hero's resource pool to ready a hero. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

name: "No Time to Waste!"
text:
When playing this card, choose one:
Quest Action: Remove "No Time to Waste!" from the game and from the Campaign Pool to reduce each player's threat by 3. Reveal the top card of the encounter deck.
Quest Action: Draw 1 card.

name: Ranger Sense
text:
When playing this card, choose one:
Action: Remove Ranger Sense from the game and from the Campaign Pool to look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand and put the rest back in any order.
Action: Draw 1 card.
